svg.title: The nurse is planning care for a client on the first post-op day after colon resection with a new colostomy. Which interventions are appropriate? Select all that apply.
svg.desc: PINK, POOP, PREPARE: PINK means the stoma is healthy and perfused, POOP means the bowel has started working (bowel sounds and output) BEFORE any feeding, and PREPARE means teach ostomy care and address BODY IMAGE before discharge. CLIENT CONFIDENCE IN SELF-CARE IS THE MOST IMPORTANT TEACHING OUTCOME - some clients will not even look at their stoma, so confidence matters even more than the steps of pouch care. A purple stoma is never expected and must be reported, and food is never advanced on hunger alone; no bowel sounds means no food.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
Ostomy
Read the situation
The nurse is planning care for a client on
the first post-op day after colon
resection with a new colostomy. Which
interventions are appropriate? Select all
that apply.
What fits here
Assess the stoma, expecting it to be pink
or beefy red and moist · Keep the client
NPO until bowel sounds return, then start
clear liquids and advance as tolerated ·
Medicate for pain so…
Why it fits
PINK, POOP, PREPARE: PINK means the stoma
is healthy and perfused, POOP means the
bowel has started working (bowel sounds
and output) BEFORE any feeding, and
PREPARE means teach ostomy care and
address BODY IMAGE before discharge.
